source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the properties of nylon (PDF 151).

items: Mazboot aur tootne ke khilaf; ragar aur ghisaav bardasht karta hai.
Lachakdar hone ki wajah se khinch sakta hai.
Phisalne wali satah jo ragar kam karti hai.
Aam taur par teilon, kai solvents aur alkalis ke khilaf mazboot.

blocks.prompt: Nylon ki kaun si khasiyat ise gears aur bearings ke liye munasib banati hai?
blocks.explanation: Is ki mazbooti aur ghisaav ki bardasht, saath is ki phisalne wali, kam ragar wali satah.

items: Nylon: mazboot, lachakdar, kam ragar, teil aur alkali ke khilaf, ooncha pighalne ka darja.
